definitions.gloss: the act or quality of waking up
definitions.explanation: describes how one wakes up, whether refreshed or groggy

examples.japanese: お{酒|さけ}を{飲|の}みすぎると{寝覚|ねざ}めが{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: If I drink too much, I wake up feeling bad.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}く{寝|ね}たので{寝覚|ねざ}めがすっきりした。
examples.english: I went to bed early, so I woke up feeling refreshed.

notes:
SLEEP VOCABULARY:
{寝覚|ねざ}め is the nominalized form of {寝覚|ねざ}める (to wake up from sleep). It describes the quality of waking up.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {寝覚|ねざ}めがいい/よい - to wake up feeling good/refreshed
- {寝覚|ねざ}めが{悪|わる}い - to wake up feeling bad/groggy
- {寝覚|ねざ}めがすっきりする - to wake up feeling refreshed

IDIOM:
{寝覚|ねざ}めが{悪|わる}い can also mean "to feel guilty" or "to have something on one's conscience."
- そんなことをしたら{寝覚|ねざ}めが{悪|わる}い - Doing such a thing would weigh on my conscience.

CONTRAST WITH {寝|ね}つき:
- {寝|ね}つき - how well you fall asleep
- {寝覚|ねざ}め - how well you wake up

RELATED:
- {目覚|めざ}め - awakening (more general)
- {起床|きしょう} - getting up
- {熟睡|じゅくすい} - deep sleep
